zh.title: 说明
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.13** 聚焦聊天流式体验、模型配置与 Goal 工作流稳定性。
本版不包含正在开发的远程控制、设备绑定或远程访问入口；这些功能留待后续版本交付。

zh.title: 新功能
items: GPT 模型支持上下文档位选择。
新增 ACP stdio Agent，支持会话模型与上下文选项。

zh.title: 优化
items: 思考流更新节流，减少流式输出期间的界面卡顿；改进滚动调度和会话状态通知。
窄窗口中的 Goal 标签可展开为整行，调整聊天 Markdown 间距与虚拟列表测量。
DeepSeek 使用远端模型目录；订阅模型配置修复名称不匹配并移除过时的 GPT-5.5 选项。
OpenCode Go 请求携带会话标识。

zh.title: 修复
items: Goal 合入工作区时创建明确的合并提交，避免继续展示已经失效的质量审查错误。
改进 Goal 调查入口与 Git 分支下拉菜单。
修复来源菜单被原生浏览器遮挡、确认弹窗主题色，以及设置页返回区域与窗口顶部留白。
本地浏览器点击前先移动指针，使悬停状态与实际点击位置一致。
多轮工具调用保留 assistant 历史，避免上下文丢失。

zh.title: CLI（仅命令行）
items: CLI 与 Desktop 使用同一版本号；归档发布状态以本版 GitHub Release 的实际资产为准。
CLI 归档中的 `peer` 与 `peer-credential-helper` 必须保留在同一目录。

en.title: Notes
items: **Peer Agent 0.0.13** focuses on streaming chat, model configuration, and Goal workflow stability.
This release excludes the remote-control implementation, device binding, and remote-access UI currently under development. Those features are reserved for a later release.

en.title: What's New
items: GPT models support selectable context tiers.
An ACP stdio agent supports session model and context options.

en.title: Improvements
items: Throttle thinking-stream updates to reduce UI stalls; improve streaming scroll scheduling and conversation-state notifications.
Expand narrow Goal chips into a full row; refine Markdown spacing and virtual-turn measurements.
Use the remote DeepSeek model catalog; repair subscription model label mismatches and retire obsolete GPT-5.5 options.
Include a session identifier on OpenCode Go requests.

en.title: Fixes
items: Create explicit merge commits when landing Goal worktrees and stop displaying stale quality-review errors.
Improve the Goal investigation entry and Git branch dropdown.
Keep source menus clear of native browser views; correct confirmation-dialog colors, settings back targets, and window-specific top spacing.
Move the pointer before local browser clicks so hover state matches the click position.
Preserve assistant history across multi-turn tool calls.

en.title: CLI (command-line only)
items: CLI and Desktop share the version number. Consult the actual GitHub Release assets for archive availability.
Keep `peer` and `peer-credential-helper` from the CLI archive in the same directory.
